published_s.note: bootstrap / unassociated AUTH at stream slot 450476741, not the trigger write set

verdict: Not a kernel bug. Old gate keyed pending_shadow by pool_idx and popped the latest s_prime on every publish, including boot. Paper auth_slot 450474933 vs publish slot 450476741 (= bootstrap_slot). The predicted S' was never compared to that swap's Yellowstone write set. Gate is now keyed by txn_signature: boot and unassociated publishes do not score.
acceptance: A sample counts only when Yellowstone txn_sig == paper sig_hex and predicted S' == next coherent S bit-exact.
